game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Merchant Waystation Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation, a waystation for merchants: the scarab scholar must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation: a waystation for merchants
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Waystation, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round, giant scorpions strike the sundial, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sundial from giant scorpions in Merchant Waystation: keep the boss_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: boss_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Merchant Waystation'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Merchant Waystation.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while boss_hp > 0.
